$$ f(\tau) = \tau $$
$$ g(t - \tau) = (t - \tau)^2 = t^2 - 2t\tau + \tau^2 $$

$$ = \int_{0}^{t} (t^2 \tau - 2t \tau^2 + \tau^3) \, d\tau $$

$$ = \left( \frac{t^2 (t^2)}{2} - \frac{2t (t^3)}{3} + \frac{t^4}{4} \right) - 0 $$
$$ = \frac{t^4}{2} - \frac{2t^4}{3} + \frac{t^4}{4} $$
